description: Source code for the class HTMLPurifier_VarParser which handles parsing and validation of string representations into native PHP variable types, including type checking and coercion.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing string representations into their corresponding native PHP variable types, providing validation, type coercion, and error handling.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Validates and converts a variable to a specific type based on provided type indicator, supporting string names and integer constants.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Subclasses should override this method to implement actual parsing logic; base implementation returns the input unchanged.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an exception with a custom message.

methods.name: errorInconsistent
methods.description: Throws an exception indicating an inconsistency in type handling, typically due to subclass extension issues.

methods.name: errorGeneric
methods.description: Generic error method for type validation failures, indicating expected and actual types.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a type given its integer constant.
